Chrisean Rock Nearly Drops Jr. On The Escalator At Target After Carrying Him All Day Because She Left His Stroller At #Blueface’s 😳👀

Chrisean Rock, whose real name is Chrisean Eugenia Malone, is a 26-year-old rapper, reality television star, and social media personality from Baltimore, Maryland. She rose to fame through her appearances on Zeus Network’s Baddies and her reality series Blueface & Chrisean: Crazy in Love. Known for her outspoken personality, viral social media moments, and songs like “Vibe,” Chrisean has built a massive following. She also shares a son, Chrisean Jesus Malone Jr., with Los Angeles rapper Blueface. Their highly publicized, on-and-off relationship has frequently made headlines across social media. 

Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter, is a 29-year-old rapper, entertainer, and internet personality from Los Angeles, California. He first exploded onto the music scene in 2018 with his viral hit “Respect My Cryppin’” before reaching mainstream success with his breakout single “Thotiana.” Known for his unique offbeat rap flow, outspoken personality, and controversial viral moments, Blueface has remained one of the most talked-about figures in West Coast entertainment. Beyond music, he has gained significant attention through livestreaming, reality television, and his highly publicized relationships, particularly with Chrisean Rock, with whom he shares a son.
